notes: Reconcile these five points against the driver. (1) EXPECTED SHARED-PRIOR MISREAD: skill1's 100-hit proc is NOT BOOM-gated — the conditional lives in the Affects clause (widens the target set to 2 surrounding enemies) whereas skill2 puts its gate in the Activation clause ('60 normal attacks ON A TARGET IN BOOM INSTALL'); a driver who pattern-matches the two lines will status-gate both and delete most of skill1's proc damage. The pre-first-burst proc assertion is the discriminator. (2) DEF ▼ CONVERSION TRAP: encoding 'DEF ▼ 35.64%' as damageTakenPct 35.64 is the nearest-wrong for the whole burst — a DEF-term cut is a flat bossDEF×0.3564 per-hit add, not a 35.64% damage scaler; the schema exposes no boss-DEF stat, so verify what primitive the engine actually has before asserting magnitudes. (3) FIXTURE: elegg is Burst II — controlComp's fixed slots include crown (also Burst II), so first-ready selection may or may not pick elegg; the tests must construct a comp where elegg demonstrably casts (assert her burstCast events exist) or her entire burst block plus skill2's gate go silently untested. (4) hitCount counts ROUNDS (MG hitsPerShot 1, ammo 300, high effective MG cadence with wind-up): skill1 procs ~3×/magazine; for skill2 clarify whether the 60-counter ACCRUES only during BOOM windows or accrues always with a fire-time gate — at MG cadence both give procs inside a 10s window but different counts (window-scoped accrual is the literal reading). (5) The once-per-battle 100% gauge fill is the kit's biggest board lever (advances the first Full Burst for the entire team) — judge it by measured-FB-count/first-FB-frame preservation, not aggregate ratio; do not let it be dropped as a non-damage utility line.
